title.narrative: The regulatory framework and the tools available to public institutions and investors operating in the energy sector are improved

description.narrative: Implementation of a massive Capacity Building program through the training of 50 selected key staffs of MIREME, CTA, ARENE, EDM and FUNAE on the area of RE technology ( solar, modern biomass and small hydro). Implementation of the Energy Efficiency Strategy and Action Plan (EESAP) to provide a comprehensive set of EE policies and tools to the government and private sector.Implementation of the Energy Information Systems, a comprehensive tool to capture all key indicators, flows and energy balances according to international norms. EIS is an important tool for policy makers and investors.Implementation of an Action on Economic Dispatch and Revenues protection for EDM. This tool will enable EDM to select the most suitable production possibility at any time of the day to meet the various demands.Implementation of a uniform financial model for the renewable energy sector to ease and standardise the formulation, evaluation, and selection of projects. Implementation of National marketoriented Biogas Program for Mozambique Implementation of the Time Of Use Tariff for EDM to optimally swift demand to greater availability of power.Efficient Lighting strategy for Mozambique that will provide an overview of the lighting market and a guideline for efficient lightingSolar/mini grid Toolbox for FUNAE to enable prefeasibility studies of sites. Feasibility study for the establishment of market oriented national biogas program for cooking and lighting.

comment.narrative: this indicator refer to the number of youth registered successfully completed skill development courses

project recordsQuality control comment August 2023 This values of 2326 605 female and 1721 male has been set to 0. Final report. The value of 12284 corresponds to 5 contributions to EURF 2.15 814 954 8048 2326 105 In all of them the EURF indicator was encoded as a logframe indicator and there arent comments in OPSYS to clarify to what it corresponds to the justification of the match and any calculations involved. From the narrative of the report is also unclear to know if there is double counting amongst the individuals reported under the different values. It is therefore decided to only report the highest value of all of them 8048 which corresponds to the number of youth registered and successfully completed skill development courses.
